h: From Seeing Holiness to Holding It in the Heart

p: with Anochi I created the upper beings;
with Anochi I created the lower beings."
That is, in the word Anochi
to the attribute of Keser Elyon,
as is written in the holy Zohar:
and this is the meaning of "the upper beings";
and there remain the letters of "Ani,"
that is, down to the lower Shechinah,
with Anochi I spoke with Yitzchak, etc.
When He revealed Himself to Yaakov,
He did not reveal Himself to him with Anochi
and said, I am Hashem,' etc.
Could it be that some sin has befallen me,
that He did not converse with me
Once HaKadosh Baruch Hu saw him,
that he was distressed over the matter,
He immediately began to speak with him with Anochi:
'And behold, I (Anochi) am with you,' etc."
Now we need to understand the expression
that He did not converse with me," etc.
that he is not fit and worthy
that He should speak with him
because he is lesser in stature
As we find that he said (Bereishis 48:15):
from my beginning until this day"
that he has nothing from his own effort.
"I lift up my eyes to the mountains"
to my teachers and to my makers, etc.
I will not lose my hope
Who creates even the lowly souls,
which are designated by the name "earth."
and said, I am Hashem," etc.,
and he saw that he too merited
a revelation of the Name Havayah,
He did not converse with him with the word Anochi
as He conversed with the forefathers
also to the attribute of Keser,
that is, that it shines in the heart
from the root in a fixed way
This is along the lines of what I heard
זֵכֶר צַדִּיק וְקָדוֹשׁ לִבְרָכָה לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
may the memory of the holy tzaddik be blessed for the life of the World to Come,
who said about the seventh day of Pesach,
regarding what is said (Mechilta, Beshalach, and elsewhere):
and he said that then they merited it
the time of the Giving of the Torah,
when they merited it also as a possession.
And this is the meaning in the Gemara
by mere sight he acquires it"
for this is only the Gemara's initial assumption,
And on the seventh day of Pesach, too,
that is, up to the aspect of Keser Elyon,
until the time of the Giving of the Torah.
Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, was distressed:
that he had merited the revelation of the Name Havayah
only by sight and not as a possession;
and this is what he said:
that he had merited only by sight.
But in truth it needs to be understood:
why did He not converse with him
with the word Anochi from the beginning,
the beginning was that he saw (Bereishis 28:12):
"And behold, a ladder set on the earth,
allude to the upper hei and the lower hei;
and this is along the lines of
and knowledge is pleasant to your soul"
that through the union of Chochmah and Binah,
which is the brain and the heart,
which is the inwardness of Keser Elyon.
And this is the beginning of
that is, up to the root,
"And you shall spread out westward and eastward," etc.,
which is the boundless heritage of Yaakov
He began to speak with him
(as is written in the holy Zohar);
and afterward there shines in him
the beginning is from the attribute of Malchus,
up to the root, from Keser Elyon.

p: And this is what it says (Bereishis 28:15):
"Hineh, behold" is an expression of joy,
'Behold, he is going out to meet you,
and he will see you and rejoice in his heart.'"
as is written in the Midrash
that immediately there shone in you
which indicates that it became fixed in the heart
that the beginning of the shining forth
For this is the level of Yaakov Avinu:
"And you shall spread out westward and eastward," etc.
And this is what it says:
what I have spoken to you"
"And you shall spread out westward and eastward," etc.,
And this is for the days of Mashiach,
when the whole world will be sanctified
with the holiness of Eretz Yisrael,
(in the Pesikta for Shabbos and Rosh Chodesh).
"Dibarti lach, I have spoken to you"
"So that your days may be multiplied,
and the days of your children,"
"With Anochi I revealed Myself to the redeemer,
'Behold, I am the God of your father';
and placed it in his mouth:
וְאָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה עִם פִּיךָ (שְׁמוֹת ד, יב)
'And I will be with your mouth' (Shemos 4:12)."
is from the side of the middle pillar,
(as is written in Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13),
for he too is a chariot
was like the face of the sun,"
"For Hashem is a sun and a shield";
"And I will be with your mouth
that is, that he would be
the root of the Written Torah.
"The engraving of the lips is difficult, etc.";
and regarding the engraving of the lips
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh:
"Peace, peace to the far and to the near"
and this is the Torah she'b'al peh,
that came to rectify the great anger.
And this is the meaning of
the word Anochi is not mentioned,
only in Parashas Vayigash, regarding Yaakov,
"I am the God, the God of your father"
which is the attribute of Chessed,
He conversed with the word Anochi,
for the holiness shone in their hearts
He gave him the good tidings (Bereishis 46:4):
"I will go down with you," etc.,
"and I will surely bring you up again."
And from this the Pesikta proved
And this is the matter of "Anochi, Anochi":
